page.layout: One page of text. At the top, the running head "PERSICO." with page number 213 at the right. Then a two-column table of months with numbers at the right of the second column, in nine rows. Below it, one block of running text in full width. At the foot, the gathering signature "O iij".

main_text.p: Ex qua oppositione apparet menses Mahar, Aben & Adar in anno Ecclesiastico postremos esse; & mensem Aben respondere Hebraeorum Schebet seu Syro Sabat. Ut ergo Syri post Sabat diem unum intercalarem adiiciunt; ita Persae post Aben quinq; dies appendices inserunt; quemadmodum Hebraei integrum mensem 30 diebus constantem intercalant post Schebet seu ante Adar, quando id rationes lunae & solis postulant. Et quemadmodum Hebraei ultimum mensem Adar ieiunio consecrant; ita Perfae fuum Adar tribuunt ieiunio, quod vocant Refeb altofeg; quamobrem Alfraganus ait in primam diem Adarmeh[?] incidere Refeb altofeg. h. e. festum ieiunii. Ante Adar diebus decem Persae viuunt Bacchanalia, quae Alfrurgen appellant; sicut Hebraei diebus undecim Purim, circa idem anni tempus vacant voluptatibus. Itaq; quinq; dies appendices, & quinque postremae dies in mense Aben constituunt decé dies bacchanalium, quòt etiā numerat Albategnius cap. 32. Quare cum in codice Alfragani Hebraeo (nam in manuscripto latino bibliothecae Palatinae horum festorum nulla fit mentio) & in Albategnio legitur, dierum decem Alfrurgen initiū esse à 16[?] die Aben; mendum est in codicibus; nam legendum est, vigesimam quintam diem mensis Aben initium esse 10

page.notes: The table has nine rows; the left column has no numbers. "Adarmeh" and "16" in the text are doubtful, and "35" beside Aben is doubtful. Printed spellings such as "decé", "quòt", "etiā" and "initiū" are kept as printed. The top right page number is 213.
